title: Integrate with Reporting API
body:
This adds steps during document and worker creation to initialize the
list of reporting endpoints, which may then be used later to direct
reports.

- [ ] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed):
   * Chrome
   * Firefox?

- [ ] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at:
   * WPT for reporting exist, and are at https://wpt.fyi/results/reporting (And are being updated to reflect the changes to the reporting API since they were written). This PR deals with the timing of initialization of document and worker reporting and is not specifically tested yet.

- [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/master/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed:
   * Chrome: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=1062359
   * Firefox: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1631237
   * Safari: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=189365
(These are all for implementing the Reporting API)
